messages:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: elevated failure-rate for rollout 'release/search-gen-canary' in us-east-1. 15m error% = 12% (> threshold). Paging oncall-ml.
Dana R: noticed errors on the frontpage search integration tests, lots of model-id mismatch logs and high tail latency.
Felix H: ui teams reporting irrelevant completions + 502s for short queries. Can confirm from APM traces latency jump around 09:12 UTC.
Oncall-ML: pulling logs now. I see routing hits to model 'search-gen-v3-unquant' even though policy should route to 'search-gen-v3-int8'. Looks like policy rule key uses metadata.tag != catalog.tag.
SRE Pager: is sticky affinity in play?
Oncall-ML: yes session_affinity=region+variant, ttl=12h. sessions created before the rollback are pinned and keep bouncing between fallback and canary edge, producing repeated runtime cache misses.
CS Rep: any customer impact list? I'm fielding a ticket from a large ecommerce tenant complaining about poor search results.
Felix H: adding to impact: search latency spikes causing JS timeouts for some customers.
Dana R: reproduce snippet from logs:
```
2026-03-15T09:11:54Z req=xyz123 user=tenant-42 route=rp-4493 model=search-gen-v3-unquant status=502 err=kv_cache_miss
2026-03-15T09:11:55Z req=xyz124 user=tenant-42 route=rp-4493 model=search-gen-v3-int8 status=200
```
SRE Pager: action plan?
Oncall-ML: propose immediate mitigations: 1) pause rollout 2) set rp-4493 session_affinity=region only 3) apply route override for us-east-1 -> search-gen-v3-int8 4) invalidate session affinity cookies via edge config 5) scale canary deployment to 0 replicas.
Product Ops: thumbs on pause? need to record reason for the rollout pause.
Dana R: pausing now: `redwoodctl rollout pause release/search-gen-canary --reason "policy mapped to wrong variant -> user errors"`
DevOps Bot: rollout pause accepted. release/search-gen-canary -> state: PAUSED.
Felix H: updating routing policy: `redwoodctl route update rp-4493 --set session_affinity=region --note "temp remove variant affinity"`
DevOps Bot: rp-4493 updated. session_affinity changed to region. propagation ETA 5s.
Oncall-ML: applying override: `redwoodctl route override --region us-east-1 --target search-gen-v3-int8 --duration 45m`
DevOps Bot: route override deployed to us-east-1 -> search-gen-v3-int8.
SRE Pager: invalidating cookies at the edge: `edgectl sessions invalidate --route rp-4493 --pattern "*"`
DevOps Bot: session invalidation requested. edge agents report 95% success within 10s. Some clients with aggressive local caching may still hold cookies.
Oncall-ML: scaling down canary: `kubectl -n inference-canaries scale deploy/search-gen-canary --replicas=0`
DevOps Bot: deployment scaled to 0 replicas.
Dana R: monitoring graphs... error-rate dropping to baseline for most tenants. A small percentage still has elevated 504/502 from old browsers.
CS Rep: communicating to affected tenants: please advise clearing session or waiting 10m for new session. I'll send templated note now.
Support Bot: automatically opened incident ticket INC-2026-348 for tracking and linked to this thread.
Product Ops: next steps before unpause?
Oncall-ML: requirements: 1) fix policy mapping logic to validate catalog tag == policy tag during rollout creation 2) add preflight synthetic check that hits a canary instance and asserts model header equals expected 3) reduce affinity ttl to 10m for canaries 4) add rollback-only sticky behavior (no variant pinning).
Felix H: I'll file a bug: INF-9501 "policy-match validation and canary affinity bug" with reproduction and proposed patch.
Dana R: also schedule a canary re-deploy once patched and tests pass. we should use region-only affinity and short TTL.
SRE Pager: preparing handoff notes for morning SRE: current state - override in place to int8, canary paused/scaled, session affinity set to region, edge invalidation ran, error-rate normal for 25m. handoff in 15m.
Oncall-ML: severity set to SEV3 (user-impacting but mitigated). creating postmortem template.
CS Rep: confirmed two enterprise tenants accepted mitigation and are validating. will update when they confirm cleared.
Product Ops: include a section in postmortem about customer comms timeline.
Dana R: tagging @Felix and @Oncall-ML to own follow-ups. I'll export the metric window and attach to INC-2026-348.
DevOps Bot: incident ticket linked to rollout and route configs. audit logs saved.
SRE Pager: if stable for next 30m, we'll close the pager and continue follow-ups via INF ticket. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
